entities.name: André Poplimont
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Georges Poplimont was a Belgian ice hockey player and fencer. As a hockey player he won a bronze medal at the 1924 European Championships and finished seventh at the 1924 Winter Olympics. As a fencer he placed fourth in the team épée event at the 1932 Summer Olympics.

entities.summary: André Georges Poplimont was a Belgian ice hockey player and fencer. As a hockey player he won a bronze medal at the 1924 European Championships and finished seventh at the 1924 Winter Olympics. As a fencer he placed fourth in the team épée event at the 1932 Summer Olympics.
